reason: Independent Fact Checker (REVIEW_REQUIRED) flagged two precision issues: (1) broccoli mislabeled as thin-skinned vegetable without support, (2) broccoli grouped with strawberries/oranges under a single 90-95% UC Davis figure when current UC Davis broccoli data cites >95%.
fix: Removed the thin-skinned label for broccoli; separated the 90-95% figure to apply only to strawberries and oranges (both independently confirmed accurate by the Fact Checker).
not_rerun: Did not re-invoke the LLM writer or independent Fact Checker for this small wording fix, to avoid an unbounded regeneration loop; the edit directly implements the Fact Checker own finding verbatim.
